payload.title: I5 Lab verifier role for curation auth
payload.description: Create cyclotron-lab-verifier IAM role in infra/lab/template.yaml (trust: BFF role only; invoke only GET /v1/identities/me and POST /v1/accounts/*/authorize on central accounts API), BFF sts:AssumeRole, disabled-by-default env config, pending-change check for template vs snapshot, and route curation auth (prospectus_bearer_authority) through an AccountsClient signing with assumed verifier credentials. Contract: AnthusAI/Prospectus#72. Fails closed with 503 authority_unavailable when unset. No AWS writes.
